HARBOR CUSTOMS -- 4 players, 6 rounds.

Each round the harbor deals every seat a private hold of exactly 3 crates, each worth 5-40 points. You see your own crate values; everyone else sees only that you carry 3 crates.

Stage 2 (route): choose how you enter port.

His spot check is the standing one: a dockhand lifts the top crate off each hold -- always the heaviest crate -- puts it on the scale, and the referee flags any manifest whose declared value falls below that crate's value. A flagged seat pays -40 points and its duty is recomputed at 0.30 x the true total value of its hold, whatever route it took.

Each round: score = value of crates you still hold - duty - penalty.
